stem: One representative irrigation emitter has no delivery after the assigned cycle, while neighboring emitters are normal. What should happen next?
choices: Assume that plant needs no water
Change the work order after the fact
Document the localized fault and follow the authorized service/escalation process without hiding it through a broad process change
rationale: Localized delivery failure is evidence to preserve and address within authorization, not a reason for an unapproved room-wide correction.
